blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police arrested a man caught transferring 1,380 liters of diesel fuel worth P129,720 following a report from a concerned citizen at the town of San Jose in Occidental Mindoro on Tuesday (Oct. 6). The man was reportedly seen loading diesel into several containers. Police said the individual claimed ownership of the fuel but failed to present documents authorizing its possession and sale or papers revealing its lawful source.
